recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. If follow-up is needed, review the Extension Pack patient-contactPriority and rank definitions for the tie/missing-priority guidance from FHIR-44603 and the later FHIR-49912 rank replacement rather than patching core.
issue_request: FHIR-44603 was an Applied/Persuasive Patient Administration change request to create a standard 0..1 positiveInt Patient.contact contact-priority extension, with guidance for equal priorities and contacts lacking a priority.
initial_application: No core implementation commit was found. Extension-pack commit a24c7b912c073437ca818dcc6766a07642ee92a8 created input/definitions/Patient/StructureDefinition-patient-contactPriority.xml, and core source/oids.ini registers the extension OID.
additional_context: The core Patient resource is active, but core does not contain the contact-priority StructureDefinition. The FHIR Extension Pack includes input/definitions/* and currently contains patient-contactPriority as a retired extension pointing to the later rank extension. Later Applied issues FHIR-50768 and FHIR-49912 broadened/deprecated the priority/preferred-contact extension family and introduced rank.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The combined branch received an empty external-repo audit commit documenting that the actionable extension source and any remaining cleanup belong in HL7/fhir-extensions.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied PA issue broadened patient-contactPriority to more contact contexts and deprecated organization-preferredContact, shaping the current Extension Pack state.
Later Applied FHIR-I issue introduced a general rank extension and directed deprecated preference/priority extensions toward it.
